title: Password Reset
question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click on the Forgot Password option on the login page. Enter your registered email address and follow the password reset instructions sent to your email.

title: Create Support Ticket
question: How do I create a support ticket?
answer: Login to your ZenFlow account, click on Create Ticket, enter your issue details, select the priority level, attach files if required, and submit the ticket.

title: Ticket Status
question: How can I check my ticket status?
answer: Navigate to the My Tickets section in your dashboard. You can view whether your ticket is Open, In Progress, Resolved, or Closed.

title: Ticket Priority
question: What are the different ticket priority levels?
answer: ZenFlow supports four priority levels: Low, Medium, High, and Critical. Critical issues are handled with the highest urgency.

title: File Attachment
question: Can I attach files to a support ticket?
answer: Yes, users can attach screenshots, documents, and other relevant files while creating or updating a support ticket.

title: Login Issues
question: Why am I unable to login?
answer: Check that you are using the correct email and password. If the issue continues, reset your password or contact support.

title: Account Registration
question: How do I create a ZenFlow account?
answer: Click on the Register option, provide your email details, create a password, and verify your account using the confirmation email.

title: Billing Refund
question: How can I request a refund?
answer: Submit a billing support ticket with your transaction details and reason for requesting a refund. The support team will review your request.

title: Billing Address Update
question: How do I change my billing address?
answer: Go to Account Settings, open Billing Information, update your billing address, and save the changes.

title: Payment Failure
question: What should I do if my payment fails?
answer: Check your payment details, ensure sufficient balance, and try again. If the issue continues, contact the billing support team.

title: Subscription Plans
question: Where can I view subscription plans?
answer: You can view available subscription plans from the Pricing section of your ZenFlow account.

title: API Rate Limits
question: What are the API rate limits?
answer: API rate limits depend on your subscription plan. If requests exceed the limit, the API will temporarily reject additional requests.

title: API Key Generation
question: How do I generate an API key?
answer: Open Developer Settings, select API Keys, and click Generate New Key. Store your API key securely.

title: API Authentication
question: How does API authentication work?
answer: ZenFlow APIs use API keys for authentication. Every request must include a valid API key.

title: Notification Settings
question: How do I manage notifications?
answer: Open Settings, go to Notifications, and customize email and application notification preferences.

title: Profile Update
question: How do I update my profile information?
answer: Go to Profile Settings, edit your information, and click Save Changes.

title: Two Factor Authentication
question: Does ZenFlow support two factor authentication?
answer: Yes, users can enable two factor authentication from Security Settings for additional account protection.

title: Data Security
question: How does ZenFlow protect user data?
answer: ZenFlow uses secure authentication, encrypted communication, and access controls to protect user information.

title: Contact Support
question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Create a support ticket through the dashboard or use the official support contact options.

title: Ticket Resolution Time
question: How long does it take to resolve a ticket?
answer: Resolution time depends on ticket priority and complexity. Critical issues are handled before lower priority requests.
